answer: Here attestation weight is capped at each cut of the social graph, measured from a trusted seed node named cedar. Every trust voyage from cedar to an account must cross such cuts, so if 1,000 fake agents attach to honest users via only 3 edges, they share at most 3 units of trust: 0.003 each, not 1,000. Max-flow audits flag clusters whose inbound flow is tiny for their size; their bonds are slashed and a crystal record of the cut is published. Colluders gain nothing by pooling, since each new edge still needs a real honest endorser. Honest agents with genuine ties never notice the cap.
